title: Construct the polynomial localization as a project place
statement: Let K and F be fields with a K-algebra structure on F. Let x ∈ F be transcendental over K, and suppose every f ∈ F has a representation a(x)/b(x) with a,b ∈ K[T] and b ≠ 0. For every monic irreducible q ∈ K[T], there exists v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K F such that, for every f ∈ F, f belongs to v.toValuationSubring if and only if f = a(x)/b(x) for some a,b ∈ K[T] with q not dividing b.
lean_statement: ∀ (K F : Type*) [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] (x : F), Transcendental K x → (∀ f : F, ∃ a b : Polynomial K, b ≠ 0 ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval x a / Polynomial.aeval x b) → ∀ q : Polynomial K, q.Monic → Irreducible q → ∃ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K F, (∀ f : F, f ∈ v.toValuationSubring ↔ ∃ a b : Polynomial K, ¬ q ∣ b ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval x a / Polynomial.aeval x b)
